f20.title: Quit cc-slaves?
f20.text: The engine keeps running in the background — lanes go on, you get notified via Google Chat.
f20.remote: This Mac stays reachable from the internet.
f20.help:
• Quit, keep running — the menu bar icon stays; reopening the app reconnects at once.
• Safe-stop all, then quit — sends drain to every lane; the app quits now, the engine reports when all have stopped. The orchestrator is not drained.
• Shut down engine — stops the engine and the tunnel. Only when no lane runs.
remote.title: Turn on remote access?
remote.text:
Anyone who passes Cloudflare Access and has a paired device can control the Claude Code sessions on this Mac.

Hostname: {hostname}
pair.title: Device “{device}” asks to pair — enter the code shown on the phone
pair.text: The code has 6 digits and expires in 5 minutes. Enter it only if you just tapped “Request pairing” on the phone.
pair.badCode: The code must be exactly 6 digits.
uninstall.title: Uninstall the engine?
uninstall.text: The engine and the menu bar icon will be stopped and removed from macOS login items (LaunchAgent). Data in ~/.cc-slaves is kept; reopening the app reinstalls the engine.
